operations: Read UTF-8 and splitlines; select inclusive one-based source_lines, excluding drop_lines; rstrip each line and join with LF.
Apply literal_replacements in listed order; every old string must occur.
Join ASCII letter + hyphen + optional whitespace + LF + ASCII letter by dropping the hyphen and intervening whitespace.
Collapse all whitespace to a single space; remove whitespace immediately before comma, semicolon, colon, full stop, question mark or exclamation point; append one LF.
editorial_scope: Whole scripture lemma and commentary body; running heads, signatures, digitization stamps and marginal apparatus omitted. Original Father labels retained. All corrections checked against the registered facsimile images; no translation or stylistic rewrite.
